title: Heap Sort Process
markdown:
Repeatedly extract the root and place it into the shrinking boundary.

![Heap Sort: Build heap and repeatedly extract extreme element (流程与复杂度)](study/assets/asset-heap-sort-%E5%A0%86%E6%8E%92%E5%BA%8F%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B%E4%B8%8E%E5%A4%8D%E6%9D%82%E5%BA%A6%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%E5%9B%BE.png)

**Order Rule**
- **Ascending sort**: use **Max-Heap** (max root moves to end $n-1, n-2, \dots$).
- **Descending sort**: use **Min-Heap** (min root moves to end).

**Phase Analysis**
1. **Build Heap**: bottom-up downheap takes $O(n)$ time.
2. **Sort Down**:
   - Swap root with last active element.
   - Shrink active heap range by 1.
   - Downheap new root ($O(\log n)$).
   - Repeat $n - 1$ times $\to \Theta(n \log n)$.
- Overall time complexity: $\Theta(n \log n)$ in best, worst, and average cases.
